core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghayur corresponds to the Arabic form غيور (Arabic root غ ي ر (gh-y-r); غيور (Ghayūr)). Its core sense is zealous for honour, protective jealousy. arabic.name: غيور
arabic.long_meaning: Ghayur (غيور) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي الغيور، ذو الغيرة. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.a: Ghayur is associated with the Arabic form غيور, whose core sense is zealous for honour, protective jealousy.

faq.q: What is the origin of Ghayur?
faq.a: Ghayur is associated with Arabic. Ghayur is a transliteration of Arabic غيور (Ghayūr) 'zealous for honour'. The source gloss 'exalted, sublime' belongs to a different root (ع ل و) and has been replaced. Same name as ghayoor.
Yes — the underlying form غيور is Arabic.
Ghayur can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.q: What does Ghayur mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Ghayur is rendered غیور and carries the sense غیرت والا، حمیت والا.

faq.q: What does Ghayur mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Ghayur is rendered غیور and carries the sense غیرتمند.
A romanized syllable approximation is ghayur. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Ghayur?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Ghayur, ghayur. Script forms are غيور, غیور, ग़यूर.

faq.q: Is Ghayur a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
